services.name: Veg pizzas
services.summary: From a ₹120 Desi Paneer to the overloaded Cheese Burst Paneer Delux. Paneer six ways, sweetcorn, mushroom, olives and jalapeño, in 8 or 10 inch.
intro: Most of our veg pizzas are built on paneer, and we make it six ways: plain, fried, spicy, tandoori, makhani and masala. Add capsicum, onion, sweetcorn, mushroom, olives, red paprika or jalapeño, and you get 44 pizzas, each a little different.

New to Hungru? The Cheesy Margherita is the simplest, the Tandoori Paneer is the one that tastes most of home, and the Cheese Burst Paneer Delux is the one to share. Every pizza here can also be made cheese burst.
services.note: 8 inch pizzas have 4 slices, 10 inch have 8. Make any pizza cheese burst for ₹120 (8 inch) or ₹200 (10 inch). Add-on toppings from ₹40, see the pizza builder.

seo.description: How Hungru Pizza collects, uses and protects your personal details, and your rights under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body:
{entity} (“we”, “us”) is a pizza café at {address}. We run this website, {website}.

Under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (the **DPDP Act**) we are the **Data Fiduciary** for the personal details you share with us. That means we decide why and how they are used, and we are responsible for keeping them safe.

This policy also follows the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011.

sections.heading: The short version
sections.body:
- We collect only what we need to make and deliver your order.
- This website has no sign-up, no adverts and no tracking or analytics cookies.
- The order form and the pizza builder do not send your details to our server. They only fill in a WhatsApp message on your phone, and nothing reaches us until you press send.
- We never sell your details or share them for marketing.
- You can ask us to show, correct or delete your details at any time.

sections.heading: What we collect and why
sections.body:
**When you order by WhatsApp, phone or the order form**
- Your name, phone number, delivery address or area, your order and any notes, such as allergies or “ring the bell twice”.
- Why: to confirm your order, make it, hand it over or deliver it, and contact you if something changes.

**When you pay**
- UPI and card payments show us your name, the payment reference and the amount. Cash needs nothing.
- Why: to match your payment to your order and keep the records that tax law asks for.

**When you apply for a job**
- Your name, phone number, the job you want, your experience, where you live and anything else you choose to tell us.
- Why: to consider you for the job, call you back and arrange a chat. Nothing else.

**When you visit this website**
- Like every website, our hosting provider automatically records technical details: your IP address, browser and device type, the page you asked for and the time.
- Why: to deliver the pages, keep the site secure and fix faults. We do not use these details to identify you or to build a profile.

We do not ask for sensitive details such as passwords, card numbers, health records or Aadhaar numbers. If you tell us about a food allergy, we use it only to make your order safely.

sections.heading: Why we are allowed to use your details
sections.body:
We use your details only:
- **With your consent.** When you send us an order or a message, you agree to us using your details for that order. You can withdraw your consent at any time (see “Your rights” below).
- **For the legitimate uses allowed by section 7 of the DPDP Act**, for example when you give us your address yourself so we can deliver, or when a law requires us to keep records, such as the GST rules.

We send offers on WhatsApp only if you ask us to, and you can stop them with one message.

sections.heading: Who we share them with
sections.body:
We never sell or rent your personal details. We share them only when needed, and only as much as needed:
- **Our own team:** the kitchen staff who make your order and the rider who delivers it.
- **Service providers who help us run the shop:** WhatsApp (Meta Platforms) for messages, our phone company for calls, your UPI app and bank for payments, our hosting provider for this website (currently Vercel Inc.) and our accountant for tax returns.
- **Google:** the map on our Contact page is provided by Google Maps. See our [cookie policy](/cookie-policy/).
- **Zomato and Swiggy**, only if you order through them: those apps collect your details under their own privacy policies and pass us what we need to make and send your order.
- **Government authorities, courts or the police**, when the law requires it, for example a food safety officer under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

sections.heading: Details stored outside India
sections.body: Some of our service providers, such as WhatsApp and our website host, may store data on servers outside India. Section 16 of the DPDP Act allows this, except to countries that the Government of India has restricted. We will follow any such restriction.

sections.heading: How long we keep your details
sections.body:
- **Order messages and delivery addresses:** up to one year after your last order, then deleted, so we can repeat “the usual” when you ask.
- **Bills and payment records:** as long as tax and accounting laws require, usually 8 years.
- **Job applications:** up to 6 months, then deleted, unless you ask us to keep yours for a later job.
- **Website technical logs:** kept by our hosting provider for a limited time, under its own policy.

When we no longer need your details and no law asks us to keep them, we delete them.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body:
Under the DPDP Act you have the right to:
- **Know** what personal details we hold about you, what we do with them and who we have shared them with.
- **Correct, complete or update** details that are wrong or out of date, such as an old address.
- **Have your details deleted** when they are no longer needed, unless a law asks us to keep them.
- **Withdraw your consent** at any time. Send us a WhatsApp message or an email saying so.
- **Have your complaint heard** by our Grievance Officer, and then by the Data Protection Board of India if you are not satisfied.
- **Nominate someone** to use these rights for you if you die or become unable to.

To use any of these rights, contact our Grievance Officer (details at the end of this page). We may ask you to confirm who you are before we act. We reply within 30 days at the most.

sections.heading: Your duties
sections.body: The DPDP Act also asks you to give us correct details, not to pretend to be someone else, and not to make false or frivolous complaints.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: Children are welcome to enjoy our pizza, but orders should be placed by an adult. We do not knowingly collect details from anyone under 18. If a child has contacted us, a parent or guardian can ask us to delete the details.

sections.heading: How we protect your details
sections.body:
We follow reasonable security practices, as section 43A of the Information Technology Act, 2000 requires:
- This website is served only over a secure (HTTPS) connection.
- Only the people who need your details for your order can see them.
- The shop phone and our accounts are protected with screen locks and passwords.
- We never see or keep your card or UPI PIN.

If a data breach ever affects your details, we will tell you and the Data Protection Board of India as the law requires.

sections.body: This website does not use cookies to track you or show adverts. Read our [cookie policy](/cookie-policy/) and [cache policy](/cache-policy/) for the details.

sections.heading: About these terms
sections.body:
These terms apply to everyone who uses {website} and to every order we accept. “We”, “us” and “our” mean {entity}, {address}. “You” means the person using this website or placing an order.

By using this website or placing an order, you agree to these terms. They are an electronic record under the Information Technology Act, 2000 and need no signature.

sections.heading: Using this website
How an order is made
sections.body:
- The order form and the pizza builder only write out a WhatsApp message for you. Sending it is a request, not a confirmed order.
- Your order is **confirmed** when we reply with the total and the expected time, and you agree.
- The price shown by the pizza builder is a website price. The total in our confirmation message is the one you pay.
- We may decline an order, for example if you are outside our delivery area or an item has sold out. We will tell you straight away.
- Orders placed through Zomato, Swiggy or another app are also covered by that app’s own terms, prices and refund rules.

sections.heading: Prices and payment
sections.body:
- Menu prices are in Indian rupees. Any tax or charge that is not already in a price is shown in our confirmation before you agree.
- Delivery charges, if any, are shown in our confirmation before you agree.
- Pay at the café, or when the order arrives. For large orders booked ahead we may ask for part of the price in advance.
- We do not accept Magicpin dining vouchers.
- We will never ask you to pay through a link sent from an unknown number. If in doubt, call us on {phone} before paying.

sections.heading: Delivery and pickup
sections.body:
- We deliver near the café, within about 5 km. The time in our confirmation is our best estimate; traffic and rain can slow us down, and we will message you if we are running late.
- Please make sure someone is there to receive the order and that your phone is on. If our rider cannot reach you after waiting and calling, the order may be treated as delivered.
- For pickup, your order is ready at the time we agreed. Pizzas taste best within 15 minutes.

sections.heading: Food, allergens and dietary needs
sections.body:
- Our kitchen uses common allergens, including wheat (gluten), milk, egg and fish. We cannot promise any item is completely free of them.
- **Tell us about any allergy when you order.** We will tell you what is in each item and whether we can make it safely.
- Veg and non-veg items are marked with the standard green and brown symbols. Both are made in the same kitchen.
- Eat delivered food soon after it arrives, and keep leftovers in the fridge.

We hold a food business licence or registration under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. The number is shown on our bills and at the café.

pages.lead: Which cookies and browser storage this website uses (very few), what other companies may set, and how you can control them.

seo.title: Cookie Policy
seo.description: This website uses no tracking or advertising cookies. See which cookies Google Maps may set, and how to control cookies in your browser.

sections.heading: What cookies are
sections.body: Cookies are small text files that a website saves in your browser. Browsers can also keep small amounts of data in “local storage”. Both can be used to remember useful things, such as keeping you signed in, or to follow you around the internet for adverts.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.body:
This website does **not** use cookies or local storage to track you, count visits or show adverts. We do not use Google Analytics, the Facebook (Meta) Pixel or any similar tool.

That is why there is no cookie banner: we do not set any cookies on visitors’ devices that need consent.

sections.heading: Cookies we use
sections.body:
**For visitors: no cookies, and one setting in local storage, only if you use it.**
- **hungru-theme** (local storage): remembers whether you chose the light or the dark look with the switch at the top of the page. It holds just the word light or dark, never leaves your browser, and stays until you clear it. Without it, the site follows your device's own setting.

**For the shop owner only:** our team edits this website through a private editing page. Signing in there sets one cookie, and the editor saves unfinished changes in that browser’s local storage. Visitors never get either of them.
- **hungru_admin** (cookie): keeps the owner signed in to the editor. Strictly necessary. Only our server can read it, and it is deleted after 7 days or on signing out.
- **hungru-admin-draft** (local storage): keeps edits that are not yet published, so they are not lost if the tab closes. Deleted when the changes are published or thrown away.

sections.heading: Cookies set by other companies
sections.body:
Some pages show content from other companies, which may set their own cookies under their own policies:
- **Google Maps:** the map on our [Contact page](/contact/). When it loads, Google may set cookies, for example to remember settings and prevent fraud. See [Google’s privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).
- **Unsplash:** some sample photos load from Unsplash’s image servers, which receive your IP address in order to send the picture. See [Unsplash’s privacy policy](https://unsplash.com/privacy).
- **WhatsApp and Google reviews:** these open only when you tap a WhatsApp or review link, and then that company’s own policy applies.

We do not control these cookies and receive no information from them.

sections.heading: How to control cookies
sections.body:
You can block or delete cookies in your browser’s settings:
- **Chrome or Edge:** Settings, then Privacy and security (in Edge: Privacy, search and services).
- **Safari on iPhone:** the Settings app, then Safari.
- **Firefox:** Settings, then Privacy & Security.

Blocking cookies does not stop this website from working. The only difference is that the Google map may not load; the Get directions button still works.

sections.heading: If this changes
sections.body: If we ever want to add cookies that are not strictly necessary, such as visitor statistics, we will update this policy first and ask for your consent before setting them, as the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 requires.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: Ask our Grievance Officer at [{email}](mailto:{email}) or on {phone}. How we handle personal details is explained in our [privacy policy](/privacy-policy/).

pages.title: Cache policy
pages.lead: How your browser and our hosting network keep copies of this website so it loads faster, what is never stored, and how to clear your cache.

seo.title: Cache Policy
seo.description: How your browser and our hosting network cache this website to make it faster, what is never cached, and how to clear your browser cache.

sections.heading: What caching is
sections.body: To open pages faster and use less mobile data, your browser keeps copies of files it has already downloaded, such as pictures, fonts and the code that runs the page. This store is called the **cache**. Our hosting provider does the same on servers around the world, so pages reach you from a server near you.

sections.heading: What is cached, and for how long
sections.body:
- **Web pages:** your browser checks with our server for a newer version every time you open a page, so you always see today’s menu and prices.
- **Code, styles and fonts:** kept for up to one year. Their file names change whenever we update the site, so your browser never uses an old version by mistake.
- **Photos:** may be kept for up to one year. A new or changed photo is saved under a new file name, so you see it straight away.
- **Sample photos from Unsplash:** cached according to Unsplash’s own settings.
- **Our hosting network:** keeps copies of our pages and files, and replaces them every time we publish an update.
- **Never cached:** the private editing page our team uses, and the file it checks to see whether an update is live.

sections.heading: No personal details in the cache
sections.body:
Every visitor gets the same pages. Nothing you type into the order form or the pizza builder is saved by this website, sent to our server or kept in a cache. Your browser may offer to remember what you type in forms; that is a setting in your browser, not part of this website.

This website does not install a service worker and does not work offline.

sections.heading: How to clear your cache
sections.body:
If a page ever looks out of date or broken, reload it first. If that does not help, clear your browser’s cache:
- **Chrome (phone or computer):** Settings, Privacy and security, Delete browsing data, then tick Cached images and files.
- **Safari on iPhone:** the Settings app, Safari, then Clear History and Website Data.
- **Firefox:** Settings, Privacy & Security, Cookies and Site Data, then Clear Data.
- **Edge:** Settings, Privacy, search and services, then Clear browsing data.

Clearing the cache is safe. The site simply downloads fresh copies the next time you visit.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: Is something not loading as it should? Call or WhatsApp us on {phone}, or email [{email}](mailto:{email}). See also our [cookie policy](/cookie-policy/).

pages.title: Refund and cancellation policy
pages.lead: When you can cancel or change an order, what we do if something goes wrong with your food, and how refunds are paid.

seo.title: Refund and Cancellation Policy
seo.description: Cancelling or changing an order with Hungru Pizza: when you can cancel, remakes and refunds for wrong or cold food, and how refunds are paid.

sections.heading: Cancelling an order
sections.body:
Tell us on WhatsApp or call {phone}. What happens depends on how far your order has got:
- **Before we start making it:** cancel for free. If you paid in advance, you get all of it back.
- **After we have started making it:** we cannot cancel it, because the food cannot be sold to anyone else. You can still collect it or have it delivered.
- **Large orders booked ahead:** free to cancel up to 2 hours before the agreed time. After that we may keep up to half of any advance to cover food already prepared, and refund the rest.
- **Orders through Zomato or Swiggy:** cancellations and refunds are handled by the app, under its own policy. Contact the app’s support first; we will help where we can.

sections.heading: Changing an order
sections.body: You can change an order until we start making it. If the new order costs more or less, we tell you the new total before we start.

sections.heading: If something is wrong
sections.body:
If your order arrives wrong, incomplete, cold, damaged or not fit to eat, send us a photo on WhatsApp within 30 minutes of delivery. We will:
- **remake and redeliver** the item as quickly as we can, or
- **refund** the price of that item, if you prefer.

You do not need to send the food back. We will never ask you to pay twice for a remake.

sections.heading: Late deliveries
sections.body: If your order reaches you much later than the time we confirmed, for a reason within our control, tell us and we will make it right, for example by refunding the delivery charge. You may also cancel before it is out for delivery and get a full refund.

sections.heading: If we cancel
sections.body: If we have to cancel your order, for example because an item has run out or the oven is down, we tell you straight away and refund everything you have paid, without deductions.

sections.heading: How and when refunds are paid
sections.body:
- Refunds go back to the UPI ID or bank account you paid from. Cash payments are refunded by UPI or in cash at the café.
- We pay within 3 working days of agreeing the refund. Your bank may take a little longer to show it.
- We do not charge any fee for a refund.

sections.heading: If you are not satisfied
sections.body:
Talk to us first. Our Grievance Officer, {officer}, will reply within 48 hours and aims to settle the matter within 30 days: email [{email}](mailto:{email}) or call {phone}.

You can also contact the National Consumer Helpline on **1915** or at [consumerhelpline.gov.in](https://consumerhelpline.gov.in). Nothing in this policy limits your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

blog.title: 8 inch or 10 inch? How to pick your pizza size
blog.excerpt: An 8 inch pizza has 4 slices and a 10 inch has 8. How many to order for one, two or a group, and what each size costs.
blog.author: Hungru Pizza

sections.body: Every pizza on our menu comes in two sizes: **8 inch** and **10 inch**. The 10 inch is cut into 8 slices instead of 4, and it is more than one and a half times as much pizza.

sections.heading: Which size for how many people?
sections.body:
- **One hungry person:** an 8 inch (4 slices), with fries or garlic bread on the side.
- **Two people:** one 10 inch (8 slices), or two 8 inch pizzas if you want two flavours.
- **Four friends:** two 10 inch pizzas and a plate of momos.

Kids' pizzas are a 7 inch size of their own, and kullad pizzas come in medium and large. See [kullad and kids' pizzas](/menu/kullad-and-kids-pizzas/).

sections.heading: What the sizes cost
sections.body:
Our veg and chicken pizzas start at ₹120 for 8 inch and ₹220 for 10 inch. The Cheesy Margherita, for example, is ₹139 or ₹220. Every price is on the [menu](/menu/).

Extras cost a little more on the 10 inch, because there is more pizza to cover. Extra cheese is ₹50 on an 8 inch and ₹65 on a 10 inch, and most toppings are ₹40 or ₹55.

sections.heading: Still not sure?
sections.body: In the [pizza builder](/build-your-pizza/) you choose the size, crust, cheese and toppings and watch the price add up. When it looks right, send it to us on WhatsApp.

blog.title: What is a cheese burst pizza?
blog.excerpt: A crust with melted cheese inside, so the edge pulls with every bite. You can have it on any pizza on our menu, for ₹120 on an 8 inch or ₹200 on a 10 inch.
blog.author: Hungru Pizza

sections.body: A cheese burst pizza has a layer of melted cheese inside the base. Bite into the crust and the cheese runs out, which is where the name comes from.

sections.heading: Can I have it on any pizza?
sections.body: Yes. Any pizza on our menu can be made cheese burst: **₹120** extra on an 8 inch and **₹200** extra on a 10 inch. Say "cheese burst" when you order, or choose it in the [pizza builder](/build-your-pizza/).

sections.heading: Which pizzas suit it best?
sections.body:
- Simple pizzas such as the **Cheesy Margherita**, where the cheese is the star.
- Paneer pizzas, for even more creaminess.
- Spicy chicken pizzas, where the cheese softens the heat.

That is a matter of taste, of course. Ask us on WhatsApp what people are ordering today.

sections.heading: Cheese burst or extra cheese?
sections.body: They are two different things. **Extra cheese** is more mozzarella on top: ₹50 on an 8 inch, ₹65 on a 10 inch. **Cheese burst** puts the cheese inside the crust. You can have both.

seo.title: What is Cheese Burst Pizza? Price and How to Order
seo.description: Cheese burst is a pizza crust filled with melted cheese. At Hungru Pizza, Barasat, any pizza can be cheese burst: ₹120 on 8 inch, ₹200 on 10 inch.

blog.title: Kids' pizzas: a frog, a lion and a mummy
blog.excerpt: Our 7 inch kids' pizzas are made to look like faces: the Baby Frog, the Cutie Lion and the Mini Halloween. What is on each one, and what they cost.
blog.author: Hungru Pizza

sections.body: Dinner is easier when the pizza looks back at you. Our kids' pizzas are 7 inch, a good size for one child, and each one is made into a face.

sections.heading: Baby Frog Pizza, ₹299
sections.body: A frog face made from paneer, tomato, sweetcorn, capsicum, onion and black olives. This one is vegetarian.

sections.heading: Cutie Lion Pizza, ₹299
sections.body: A lion face made from chicken keema, chicken salami, chicken sausage, onion and olives, with olive eyes and onion whiskers.

sections.heading: Mini Halloween Pizza, ₹199
sections.body: A mummy wrapped in strips of melted cheese, with chicken, tomato, onion and capsicum.

sections.heading: How to order
sections.body: The kids' pizzas are on our [kullad and kids' menu](/menu/kullad-and-kids-pizzas/). Order them on WhatsApp like anything else, or come and eat them at the café in Colony More.
